t: This is the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel, on the Docklands riverside. It belongs to the Hilton family of hotels, founded by Conrad Hilton. He was an American hotelier who bought his first hotel in Cisco, Texas, in 1919 and went on to build the world's first international hotel chain. When he died in 1979, he left most of his estate to the Conrad N. Hilton Foundation.
